items.description: Essakane Gold Mine is a major gold operation in northern Burkina Faso. It is one of the country's best-known mining sites and a major employer in the Sahel Region.
Hounde Gold Mine is an important gold project in southwestern Burkina Faso. It adds industrial activity to a region that is otherwise dominated by farming.
Boungou Gold Mine is a gold site in eastern Burkina Faso. It sits in a dry savanna zone where mining plays a big role in the local economy.
Perkoa Zinc Mine is a key zinc project in west-central Burkina Faso. It is one of the country's most important non-gold mining sites.
Bobo Inter Dry Port is an inland logistics hub in Bobo-Dioulasso. It helps move cargo between western Burkina Faso and the rest of the country.
Ouagarinter Dry Port is the main inland freight hub for Ouagadougou. It supports storage, customs handling, and cargo movement for the capital area.
Tambao Manganese Mine is a notable mineral site in northern Burkina Faso. It is closely associated with the country's wider effort to diversify mining output.
SOFITEX Bobo-Dioulasso is tied to Burkina Faso's cotton industry in the west of the country. It reflects the importance of cotton collection and processing in regional trade.
SN-SOSUCO Banfora is the country's main sugar producer in the southwest. The plant processes sugar cane from nearby plantations and feeds the domestic market.
CIMBURKINA Ouagadougou is a major cement plant in the capital. It supplies building materials for construction across the urban region.
Zagtouli Solar Plant is a large photovoltaic site near Ouagadougou. It adds renewable power to the national grid and is a flagship energy project.
SONABHY Bingo Depot is a fuel storage site serving the Ouagadougou area. It is a key piece of Burkina Faso's petroleum supply chain.
Brakina Ouagadougou is the country's best-known brewery site. It plays a central role in beverage production for the capital and the national market.
Sanbrado Gold Mine is a modern gold project in central Burkina Faso. It is one of the newer large-scale mining sites in the country.
FILSAH Textile Mill is a cotton processing site in Koudougou. It helps turn local cotton into industrial output instead of exporting only raw fiber.
